text:
claire: Quick thread  planning a 30-min "Launch Labs" (Jun 3). Goal: push demo attendees to first-success by bundling persona-specific quick-start prompt packs + micro credits. Need the experiment matrix, routing, and short benchmark copy.

tomo: I suggest 3 arms: Control (docs), Pack-only, Pack + 40 credits + 48h in-app nudge. Keep sample sizes small for budget.

jess: Metrics to record: registered, attended, pack_opened, credits_issued, credits_redeemed, first_success, active_7d, tokens_first_week. Include cohort_id and persona everywhere.

felix: Landing form: persona dropdown (Product/Data/Infra), opt-in credits checkbox. Routing: persona -> nurture-list; add preferred_model & fallback_model fields to webhook. If dedicated saturated, fallback to hosted.

felix: Webhook example:```json
{"event":"launchlabs_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"product","cohort_id":"launchlabs-jun3-b","preferred_model":"redwood-ded-1","fallback_model":"redwood-hosted-1","utm_campaign":"launchlabs-jun3"}
```

jess: UX test idea: show a short-lived header CTA "Use your starter credits" for 5 days vs none on 25% of arm with credits. Cap campaign to $7k and alert #finance at 75%.

tomo: Copy hooks for social/landing hero: "Launch Labs: build an LLM demo in one session  starter prompts & credits for attendees." CTA variants: "Reserve spot", "Claim starter pack".

claire: Benchmark blurb for slides: before: high setup friction -> avg tokens/session 250; after packs: avg tokens/session 600 with higher success rate. Slide with est cost/user (credits$ + infra). Keep numbers placeholder.

jess: Add model_used field on credits_redeemed so we can compute cost by model. Also include cohort_id in email CTA links.

campaign-bot: Event created: launchlabs-jun3. Reminders set 48h, 1h.

claire: Owners & next steps: tracking doc (jess), prompt packs (tomo), landing + emails (claire), ops: webhook + cap enforcement (felix). Deadline EOD Tue. Quick sync 9am tomorrow? :coffee:
